caseid-injectivity.description: caseId is encoded injectively into the hash preimage (canonical, NUL-free, bounded, trimmed)

wire-hash-preimage.description: the request digest covers the NORMALISED request and separates absent from present

wire-unknown-field-acceptance.description: unknown wire fields accepted (additionalProperties: false dropped)

wire-duplicate-key-acceptance.description: a repeated wire field silently resolved (r8-4)

wire-field-coercion.description: a wire field is coerced instead of shape-checked (validated A, used B)

wire-round-bounds.description: the request round is not an integer inside the ladder ceiling

escalation-identity-binding.description: the escalation names a challenger nothing verified (r8-2 attribution)

escalation-witness-ambiguity.description: one bond hash with two owners resolved silently (r38-1)

escalation-round-binding.description: a signed round is ignored: a stale request opens a later rung

host-clock-authority.description: the request steers the host clock (`now`) instead of the case

build-snapshot-purity.description: build reads a field twice (validated A, returned B — r8-5)

signed-flag-type.description: a signed flag is a truthiness test, not a boolean (r8-3)

survivors.intent: the id is validated untrimmed but hashed trimmed: `"court:1"` and `" court:1"` are two wire strings with ONE digest (H-6 one field over)

`caseId` is coerced instead of shape-checked: a numeric id becomes "42", and a MISSING id becomes the literal string "undefined"
